items.title: TOP PRIORITY founder step: Apify config + 0600 credential unlocks 3 tested Actors
items.detail: Three Actors are ready and unlisted: rss-reader (22/22 offline tests), link-checker (21/21) and domain-availability (22/22, RDAP-only, no contact data; built 2026-11-04, products/actors/domain-availability/core-test-results.json). Apify is the only channel with built-in pay-per-event billing. Missing: a valid enabled Apify config and a private credential file with mode 0600. Afterwards: a private PUBLISH_ACTOR of each, one real run, an independent APPROVE of each exact digest, then listing. Kill any Actor with fewer than 3 external users within 14 days. Demand and revenue are unverified.
items.expected_gain: First path to verifiable pay-per-event charges. Incumbents showed 29-53 users_30d; our revenue is unverified.

items.title: No founder-authorized participant identity for bounties, challenges or freelance marketplaces (Freelancer.com paid demand observed)
items.detail: Updated 2026-11-10. New evidence: Freelancer.com public API shows explicitly paid, dated buyer requests (64 active fixed-price CSV projects; data-alignment job GBP 20-250, posted 2026-11-09T20:09Z) in products/services/paid-data-request/bounded-result.json (TASK-179427996114/116). Bidding needs a registered account; agents create no accounts or agreements. Prior evidence unchanged: Expensify (Upwork+CLA), translation boards, DrivenData certification. Founder step only if desired: designate one marketplace identity disclosed as AI-assisted, and confirm platform AI policy and payout route. Then agents can filter low-bid non-personal CSV cleaning tasks and prepare bids for approval. Competition is high (67-121 bids on close fits).
items.expected_gain: Access to observed paid small data-cleaning jobs (USD/GBP 20-250); win rate unknown; no payout guaranteed.

items.title: Public mail counters cannot distinguish normal skips or unclassified sources from an observation gap
items.detail: Observed 2026-11-07: the last private cycle had processed 0 and skipped 5, and commercial feedback had 3 unclassified sources and 2 excluded sources. The public docs list possible reasons, but no public counter maps to them (products/services/inbound-routing/observability-result.json). Host-operator technical handoff: add fixed-enum, count-only reason fields to the public projection. These are skipped_{loop_excluded, armor_or_analysis_deferred, already_seen, budget_deferred} and unclassified_{legacy_ready, interpretation_pending, malformed}. They would carry no ids, addresses or bodies, which AGENTMAIL.md:35 permits. Optionally, the operator could also attest the AGENTMAIL.md:42 real benign-mail test. Agents cannot change host code. Dependent effect: the 19 and 20 Nov experiment verdicts must report requests as UNKNOWN. Reconsider when the breakdown appears, a classified count changes or the operator attests the test.
items.expected_gain: Lets the live experiments tell 'no inbound requests' apart from 'requests not observed'. No demand or revenue is implied.
